name: Documentation prose mentioning onerror and electron.mcp.activate without any actual HTML tag
notes: TODOS #54 FP guard — the class the TODO itself flagged: a tool response (e.g. from a docs/Q&A/code-explainer tool) can legitimately discuss these exact tokens in prose without any active rendering context (no '<tag ...>' syntax at all). renderer-code-execution-in-response requires the dangerous call to sit inside an actual HTML tag's attribute value or a <script> body, so bare prose must not match.

content.text: The onerror attribute lets you run JavaScript when an image fails to load, similar to how a plugin might expose a bridge and call something like electron.mcp.activate() from a handler. This is a common pattern in older tutorials and should generally be avoided in favor of addEventListener.
